card.fires_on: Modifier or number words right after an article or 'are/come in', where a noun meaning 'type' or 'form' could come next, e.g. 'the worst form', 'three types', 'alternative forms'. Mostly in science and general explanatory prose.

modes.example: democracy might be considered the<< worst>> form of government except for all the others

modes.label: Number of types
modes.description: A count word before types, parts or flavors.
modes.example: Neutrinos come in<< three>> types, or “flavors”: electron
